request.style: English, female solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, warm and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus
Saw the city full of idols all around
He looked at the objects of their worship
And found an altar with a hidden sound
To an unknown god it was inscribed
What you worship in ignorance I will explain
The God who made the world and everything in it
Does not live in temples made by human hands

[Pre-Chorus]
He gives everyone life and breath and all things
From one man he made every nation
To seek God and perhaps reach out for him
Though he is not far from any one of us

[Chorus]
In him we live and move and have our being
We are his offspring as the poets say
So we ought not to think that the divine being
Is like gold or silver shaped by human skill

[Verse]
God overlooked the times of ignorance past
But now he commands all people to repent
He has set a day to judge the world with justice
By the man he has appointed for the end
He has given proof of this to everyone
By raising him from the dead in glory's light

[Chorus]
In him we live and move and have our being
We are his offspring as the poets say
So we ought not to think that the divine being
Is like gold or silver shaped by human skill

[Bridge]
Some began to mock when they heard of the resurrection
But others said we will hear you again
Damaris joined him and came to believe
A woman from Athens in the center of the plan

[Outro]
And others with them believed in the risen Lord
The gospel reached the mind and the heart of man
